events.title: 리버풀 beat 맨체스터 시티 2–1 in a crunch League match at Anfield . 입스위치 타운 continue their challenge by winning 1–0 at 노리치 시티.

The Football League Cup final is decided at the third attempt when 애스턴 빌라 beat 에버턴 3–2 in the second replay at Old Trafford . A last minute goal from Brian Little sends the trophy to Villa Park and prevents the game from going to a third replay.

에버턴 and 리버풀 draw 2–2 in the FA Cup semi-final at Maine Road , with referee Clive Thomas disallowing a late goal from 에버턴's Bryan 해밀턴 . At Hillsborough, 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 리즈 유나이티드 2–1 to reach the final for the second consecutive year.
리버풀 beat 에버턴 3–0 in the semi-final replay to reach the FA Cup final.

리버풀 effectively end 입스위치 타운's title challenge by beating them 2–1 at Anfield. 맨체스터 시티 crash to a 4–0 defeat at relegation-threatened 더비 카운티 and are now two points behind the Reds having played a game more. Meanwhile, half the clubs in the division remain in danger of relegation: 브리스틀 시티 are bottom, but just five points separate the ten teams immediately above them, with 토트넘 홋스퍼 in most danger, having played more games than their rivals.
